propositions: No aggregated lens currently exists to answer trend questions across 344 closed bugs: close_class distribution by month, detection channel, age of open bugs, caused_by component fan-in, and time-to-close percentiles are answered only via ad-hoc scripts.

Pre-convention bugs (~214) lack close_class field; the lens must surface this era-skew explicitly as a labeled MISSING cohort rather than silently omitting or merging legacy data with classified records.
The detected_by field is sparsely populated and will remain absent during rollout; the lens must gracefully degrade that single dimension to unavailable state without affecting other five dimensions.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) must filter on close-transition timestamp within the CLI range window (30-day default), while stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by distribution, caused_by fan-in) are point-in-time measures over the current store and deliberately ignore the range parameter.
Edge cases must not crash: zero-bug stores return unavailable state per registry convention; detected_by-absent stores leave only that dimension unavailable; non-bug records are correctly excluded.
